shortDescription: Configures qos features on icx switch.

options.name: attach_egress_buffer_profile
options.description: Attaches a user-configured egress buffer profile to one or more ports.

options.name: check_running_config
options.description: Check running configuration. This can be set as environment variable. Module will use environment variable value(default:False), unless it is overridden, by specifying it as module parameter.

options.name: dscp_priority
options.description: Changes the differentiated Services Code Point (DSCP)-to-internal-forwarding-priority mappings..

options.name: egress_buffer_profile_7150
options.description: Configures an egress buffer profile for the share port level. This is supported only on ICX 7150. The default egress buffer profile level is level4-1/9 for 1/9 of the buffers in buffer memory.

options.name: egress_buffer_profile_7X50
options.description: Configures an egress buffer profile for the share queue level. This command is supported only on Ruckus ICX 7250, ICX 7450, and ICX 7750 devices. The default egress buffer profile level is level4-1/9 for 1/9 of the buffers in buffer memory. This is not supported on ICX 7150

options.name: egress_shape_ifg_bytes
options.description: Configures egress shaper IFG bytes. By default a value of 20 is configured.

options.name: ingress_buffer_profile
options.description: Configures an ingress buffer profile. By default an ingress buffer profile is not configured. This command is supported only on Ruckus ICX 7250, ICX 7450, and ICX 7750 devices. This command is not supported on the Ruckus ICX 7150 or the Ruckus ICX 7650. For PFC disabled ports, the default PG XOFF limit is level7-1/2. For PFC enabled ports, the default PG XOFF limit is level2-1/32.

options.name: internal_trunk_queue
options.description: Modifies the dynamic buffer-share level of inter-packet-processor (inter-pp) HiGig links egress queues on ICX 7450 devices. This command is supported only on ICX 7450 devices or across stack units or for ports across master and slave packet-processor (pp) devices in ICX7450-48 units.

options.name: mechanism
options.description: Configures the Quality of Service (QoS) queuing method. Default is WRR

options.name: monitor_queue_drop_counters
options.description: Configures the port that the Ruckus ICX 7150 device monitors for the incrementing of the egress queue drop counters.

options.name: priority_to_pg
options.description: Configures priority-to-priority-group (PG) mapping for priority flow control (PFC). This command is supported only on Ruckus ICX 7250, ICX 7450, and ICX 7750 devices. This command is not supported on the Ruckus ICX 7150 or the Ruckus ICX 7650.

options.name: profile
options.description: Changes the minimum bandwidth percentages of the eight Weighted Round Robin (WRR) queues.

options.name: queue_name
options.description: Renames the queue. The default queue names are qosp7, qosp6, qosp5, qosp4, qosp3, qosp2, qosp1, and qosp0.

options.name: scheduler_profile
options.description: Configures a user-defined Quality of Service (QoS) scheduler profile. Either scheduling-mechanism or profile weight must be specfied.

options.name: sflow_set_cpu_rate_limit
options.description: Sets the CPU rate limit for sFlow. A CPU rate limit for sFlow is configured with the default values of 100 sFlow sampled packets per second (PPS) and a burst size of 5000 B.

options.name: tagged_priority
options.description: Changes the VLAN priority of 802.1p to hardware forwarding queue mappings.
